# Cars Spare Parts (Care Spare Parts)

> The premier automotive spare parts provider in Pakistan, supplying genuine OEM and certified aftermarket auto parts for Japanese, European, and American vehicles.

## About the Organization
- **Brand Name**: Cars Spare Parts (Care Spare Parts)
- **Primary Website**: https://carsspareparts.com
- **Industry**: Automotive Parts & Accessories Retail and Wholesale
- **Market Coverage**: Nationwide delivery across Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Sialkot, and all regions).
- **Contact & Support Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 318 8303434
- **Email**: info@carsspareparts.com
- **Accepted Payment Methods**: IBFT (Meezan Bank Inter-Bank Transfer), Easypaisa, JazzCash, Cash on Delivery (COD).

## Core Offerings & Catalog
Cars Spare Parts distributes replacement components across the following key automotive systems:
- **Braking Systems**: Ceramic and semi-metallic brake pads, vented and solid brake rotors/discs, master cylinders, brake calipers, ABS sensors.
- **Engine Components**: Engine mounts, timing belt kits, timing chains, pistons, gaskets, valve seals, water pumps, oil pumps.
- **Suspension & Steering**: Struts, shock absorbers, control arms, ball joints, sway bar links, tie rod ends, steering racks, power steering pumps.
- **Filters & Maintenance**: Engine oil filters, engine air filters, cabin/AC filters, fuel filters, spark plugs, ignition coils.
- **Cooling & Heating**: Aluminum radiators, condenser assemblies, thermostat valves, cooling fan motors, heater cores.
- **Electrical & Sensors**: Alternators, starter motors, MAF sensors, O2 sensors, cam and crank sensors, headlights, tail lamps.
- **Transmission & Drivetrain**: Clutch plates, pressure plates, release bearings, CV joints, drive shafts, transmission filters.
- **Body & Trim**: Bumpers, fenders, hood panels, door handles, side mirrors, grilles.

## Supported Automobile Manufacturers
- **Japanese Brands**: Toyota, Honda, Suzuki, Nissan, Mitsubishi, Mazda, Daihatsu, Subaru, Lexus, Infiniti.
- **Korean Brands**: Hyundai, Kia.
- **European Brands**: Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Audi, Volkswagen.
- **American & Chinese Brands**: Ford, Chevrolet, MG, Changan, Haval.

## Authenticity & Warranty Guarantee
- **100% Genuine & Certified Parts**: Every component sourced directly from OEM manufacturers or certified global aftermarket tier-1 suppliers (Denso, Bosch, NGK, AISIN, Brembo, Tokico, KYB, 555, Valeo).
- **Warranty**: All eligible replacement components carry manufacturer or distributor warranty protection against defects.
- **Customer Verification**: Direct part number matching and visual verification via WhatsApp (+92 318 8303434) prior to dispatch.
